rules.message: A parent select must send its own value (data-hx-include="this") — htmx GETs do not include the enclosing form by default.
A parent select declares its child as the target (data-hx-target="#<child-id>").
Swap the child select whole (data-hx-swap="outerHTML") so its id, name, and htmx wiring come back consistent.
The child target should exist in the document. (warn: server fragments reference elements elsewhere on the page)
